paragraphs: An ongoing outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts has sickened 76 people across 16 states, with 6 hospitalizations reported [1]. The outbreak involves multiple strains of E. coli and Salmonella Agona [1]. In better news, the Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños that sickened 488 people across 34 states is now over [2].

Stewart's Shops Corp. is recalling Heavenly Medley and Vanilla-Chocolate-Strawberry half-gallon ice cream due to possible metal contamination [4]. WinCo Foods is recalling Salsa Bean Dip Trays because they contain recalled peperoncini from G.L. Mezzetta [7]. Saint Francis Apizza LLC is recalling frozen pizzas in Pepperoni, Plain Cheese, Supreme, and Mushroom and Onion varieties because soy allergen labeling is missing [9]. Sierra Nevada Cheese Company is recalling all Graziers Raw Milk Cheese due to potential E. coli O26:H11 contamination [12].

Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A. is recalling additional lots of Great Value Frozen Organic Triple Berry Blend and Blueberries, plus one lot of Trader Joe's Frozen Organic Mixed Berry Blend, due to potential E. coli O145 contamination [6]. EAK Distribution is recalling HOME GROWN Green Sprouting Calabrese Broccoli Seeds because of possible Salmonella contamination [5]. Todd's Seeds LLC is recalling sprouting seeds sold via Amazon and direct to consumers because they may be contaminated with Salmonella and E. coli [15].
